productConcept.name: Sounding Line
productConcept.description: A private hydrographic survey consultancy based in Galway, Ireland, producing precision bathymetric charts and tidal study instruments for coastal infrastructure engineers since 1967.
productConcept.rationale: Flint Shore's editorial serif (Fraunces) and warm cream palette (#fcf7f1) map to physical materiality. The concept_by_image.md describes 'pebbles pulled from shore water — cream, charcoal, slate blue, each polished and particular.' A hydrographic survey practice — measuring ocean depth, making precision charts, manufacturing brass instruments — inhabits exactly this register: old-world craft precision, physical materiality, and technical seriousness without digital gloss.
